answer: Each identity binds one gym membership: the gym signs its hash and a 60-day log of 12 visits into the Plume Registry, and each visit stamps the member's marble pass. A 30 POA bond locks 90 days and doubles per extra membership from one funding cluster (30/60/120, capped 960 POA), so 100 fakes lock 92,130 POA plus 10,500 POA in broker fees. A per-epoch delta check re-confirms attendance within 72 hours; two misses forfeit half the bond and freeze payouts 3 epochs; a duplicate membership slashes both bonds. Where no partner gym exists, a doctor-signed fitness record passes with a doubled bond.
